items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: They had a guy named Walter Botts, who had been with Doc for years. And, he was a very handsome guy. He was a wonderful, C Melody sax player.

ctx.x: Well, did they, did you, were you on that famous parade? When the horseback?

No. I had gotten in just the day before. And, I followed behind the parade in the Dodge 4 with my wife and her aunt. But, they, they did parade. They did parade. On the horses. And, it was a sight to behold, I'm telling you. All these musicians, some of them could ride, some of them couldn't. But, anyway. Fantastic. They went out to the Biltmore Hotel. And, hitched the horses. How many? And, it was about 90's bands. Big band for those days. They had a lot of, I have pictures, I want you to see them. So, if you…
